name: Edible Bone Phosphate
aliases: INS 542, edible bone phosphate, bone phosphate, bone meal phosphate, tribasic calcium phosphate from bone
what_is: A mineral food additive prepared from animal bone material and identified by JECFA as edible bone phosphate, INS 542.
why_botia: BOTIA flags INS 542 because its name indicates an animal-derived ingredient and it can also perform technological functions such as emulsifying, humectant or sequestrant roles. A generic declaration does not identify the animal species.
can_1: Detect INS 542, edible bone phosphate and bone phosphate when explicitly declared.
can_2: Trigger animal-origin, texture and numbering context for the declared ingredient.
cannot_1: Identify the source animal when the label says only bone phosphate.
cannot_2: Determine processing details, religious suitability or certification status from the generic ingredient name.
